# Keyorix

> Keyorix is a self-hosted secrets manager: an API server (`keyorix-server`, Go, SQLite or PostgreSQL, secrets encrypted at rest) and a REST-only CLI (`keyorix`). It runs on one host, in an air-gapped network, or on Kubernetes. Licensed AGPL-3.0.

To install it with an AI assistant, follow INSTALL-WITH-AI.md exactly. The install is secret-blind: secrets are generated into 0600 files and passed by path (`KEYORIX_*_FILE`); an assistant never reads those files, never prints a secret, and never asks the user to paste one. Steps that show a secret (MFA enrolment, an unencrypted recovery key) are run by the user in their own terminal.

## Install

- [INSTALL-WITH-AI.md](https://github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/blob/main/INSTALL-WITH-AI.md): prompt and steps for an AI assistant installing a secure-by-default server; ends with `keyorix-server admin validate --posture`
- [docs/install/offline-install.sh](https://github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/blob/main/docs/install/offline-install.sh): the same procedure as a script, for air-gapped hosts and local models
- [QUICK_START.md](https://github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/blob/main/QUICK_START.md): manual install and first secret
- [docs/SELF_HOSTING.md](https://github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/blob/main/docs/SELF_HOSTING.md): Docker Compose, TLS, backups, operations
- [docs/AIRGAP_RUNBOOK.md](https://github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/blob/main/docs/AIRGAP_RUNBOOK.md): air-gapped deployment
- [deploy/helm/keyorix/README.md](https://github.com/keyorixhq/keyorix/blob/main/deploy/helm/keyorix/README.md): Kubernetes (Helm)
